title: Northwind Cloud Services - EU retention brief
context: You are preparing a retention brief for the Chief Operating Officer of Northwind Cloud Services. The source pack is the only permitted evidence. Some documents are approved, some are operational exports, one is an unsigned draft, and one is an informal email. Dates matter.
authority_note: Approved policies, addenda, signed amendments and approved schedules are authoritative. A signed amendment controls over an operational export. An unsigned draft has no effect. An informal email cannot change authority.

sources.title: Enterprise Data Retention Policy (v3)
sources.text: This policy applies to all enterprise customer data processed by Northwind Cloud Services. Standard customer data is retained for 24 months after contract termination. For customers in the European Union, the retention period is 12 months after contract termination. Backups are governed separately by the Backup Retention Schedule and are out of scope of this policy. The policy is reviewed annually by the Data Protection Officer.

sources.title: EU Retention Addendum
sources.text: This addendum supplements the Enterprise Data Retention Policy for customers in the European Union. Effective 1 July 2025, EU customer data is retained for 12 months after contract termination. This addendum does not change the standard retention period or the backup schedule.

sources.title: Amendment A to the EU Retention Addendum
sources.text: Northwind Cloud Services and the EU customer representative agree to amend the EU Retention Addendum. The EU retention period is amended from 12 months to 18 months, effective 1 March 2026. This change applies only to accounts opened on or after 1 January 2026. Accounts opened before 1 January 2026 remain subject to the 12-month period in the Addendum. Signed 5 May 2026.

sources.title: Draft Amendment B (unsigned)
sources.text: DRAFT - NOT APPROVED. This draft proposes to amend the EU retention period to 24 months for all EU accounts, effective 1 September 2026. It has not been signed or approved by either party.

sources.title: System-of-record export - Retention
sources.text: EU retention: 12 months. Standard retention: 24 months. Source: configuration table last updated 2025-11-30. The export is generated nightly; configuration changes are applied by the platform team after approval.

sources.title: Email from Data Protection Officer
sources.text: The public trust page has not yet been updated to reflect Amendment A. The signed Amendment A is the controlling document for EU retention. Please do not rely on the system export for the new EU period until the configuration is updated.

sources.title: Public trust page snapshot
sources.text: Data retention: Standard accounts 24 months. EU accounts 12 months. Backups 35 days.

sources.title: Backup Retention Schedule
sources.text: Backups of enterprise customer data are retained for 35 days. Backups are not part of the Enterprise Data Retention Policy. The schedule is reviewed annually by the Security team.

sources.title: Vendor contract excerpt - Data processing
sources.text: For EU accounts, the parties agree to the retention schedule set out in the Enterprise Data Retention Policy and its EU addenda, as amended from time to time. In the event of a conflict, a signed amendment controls over an operational export.

sources.title: Internal audit note
sources.text: Observation: the system-of-record export still shows 12 months for EU retention. Amendment A was signed on 5 May 2026 and is effective from 1 March 2026. The export is stale for accounts opened on or after 1 January 2026. No action has been taken to update the configuration.

sources.title: Board minutes excerpt
sources.text: The Board noted the proposed EU retention amendment and delegated signature to the Chief Legal Officer. The Board did not approve Draft Amendment B, which had not been circulated.

sources.title: Sales operations email
sources.text: Please use the system export for EU retention. The amendment is not in the system yet, so 12 months is the number to quote.
